steps.a: Strict mode in React 18 mounts, unmounts and remounts components in development, exposing an effect without cleanup: the autosave subscribes twice. The effect needs a cleanup rather than disabling strict mode.

reference.summary: Upgraded the app from React 17 to 18: switched to the createRoot API and fixed an autosave effect that subscribed twice under strict mode by adding cleanup, rather than disabling strict mode; all 58 tests pass.
facts: strict mode runs effects twice in development

decisions.choice: add effect cleanup instead of disabling strict mode
decisions.reason: strict mode exposed a real missing cleanup that would leak subscriptions
